hints.title: Core Idea
hints.text: Identify each user's earliest chronological session using ROW_NUMBER() or `rank`() ordered by session_start.

hints.title: Key Observation
hints.text: Filter for users whose first session type was 'Viewer'.

hints.title: Query Construction
hints.text: Count their subsequent 'Streamer' sessions and return those with at least one streamer session, ordered by session count descending then user_id descending.

hints.title: Implementation
hints.text:
```mysql
WITH FirstSessions AS (
    SELECT 
        user_id, 
        session_type, 
        RANK() OVER(PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY session_start) AS session_rank 
    FROM Sessions 
), ViewerFirst AS (
    SELECT user_id 
    FROM FirstSessions 
    WHERE session_rank = 1 
      AND session_type = 'Viewer' 
) 
SELECT 
    Sessions.user_id, 
    COUNT(*) AS sessions_count 
FROM Sessions 
INNER JOIN ViewerFirst USING (user_id) 
WHERE Sessions.session_type = 'Streamer' 
GROUP BY 1 
ORDER BY sessions_count DESC, Sessions.user_id DESC;
```

variables: N: total records in Sessions table
complexity.notes: Partitioned window ranking followed by inner join filtering and aggregation.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Correlated subqueries per user incur quadratic runtime.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognize that first session condition requires window ranking on session_start.
